commit 12b8393ef0a0edc0484ab2c2f1dfd0a8a76208b0
Author:     Justin Tracey <jtracey@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Wed Mar 4 17:25:45 2026 -0500
Commit:     Justin Tracey <jtracey@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Wed Mar 4 17:25:45 2026 -0500

    Bug 2020723 - Update `setOverLink` with new m-c changes. r=kaie,mkmelin
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D285767

diff --git a/mail/base/content/mailWindow.js b/mail/base/content/mailWindow.js
index 431f6a33baa..95ffb95bd25 100644
--- a/mail/base/content/mailWindow.js
+++ b/mail/base/content/mailWindow.js
@@ -368,9 +368,11 @@ nsMsgStatusFeedback.prototype = {
       url = Services.textToSubURI.unEscapeURIForUI(url);
 
       // Encode bidirectional formatting characters.
-      // (RFC 3987 sections 3.2 and 4.1 paragraph 6)
+      //
+      // https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#url-rendering-i18n
+      // https://www.unicode.org/reports/tr9/#Directional_Formatting_Characters
       url = url.replace(
-        /[\u200e\u200f\u202a\u202b\u202c\u202d\u202e]/g,
+        /[\u061c\u200e\u200f\u202a-\u202e\u2066-\u2069]/g,
         encodeURIComponent
       );
     }
title: Bug 2020723 - Update `setOverLink` with new m-c changes. r=kaie,mkmelin
